admission_states.admitted: The selected GM1 execution path has a coupled implementation and evidence.
admission_states.identity: The native value disables the family and requires no tendency operator.
admission_states.operator-only: One or more independently validated operators exist, but the complete native family/cadence is not coupled.
admission_states.partial: Some implementation exists, but it is not a selectable complete family.
admission_states.unported: No GM1 implementation is admitted; selection must fail closed.

implemented_slice.default_authority: CM1 supplies no compiled default (src/param.F:1567-1580) but ships ihail=1 in run/namelist.input:56 and run/config_files/supercell/namelist.input:55.  GM1 bound 0 for wsm6-mp6 until 2026-09; the default moved to CM1's answer and every WSM6 run's words moved with it.  Neither Thompson has a dense-ice branch at all and a declared value there is refused. wdm6-mp16 would bind WRF's own hail_opt default of 0, but the component is not selectable.

ipbl.gm1_extension_note: GM1 additionally admits closures.ipbl = 11, which is not a CM1 r21.1 value: it is WRF bl_pbl_physics=11, the scale-aware Shin-Hong scheme ArWen ships and CM1 does not. ipbl.gm1_note: ipbl=1, 4, 6 and the GM1 extension 11 resolve to byte-audited ArWen components (cm1core.arwen_physics_component); every one of them is uncoupled because GM1 carries none of hfx, qfx, psim, psih, br, wspd, u10, v10, xland or psfc on the device. ipbl=2 is CM1 own inline scheme and ipbl=3 and 5 have no ArWen counterpart.
